notes: OCI Saudi Arabia West region became available 2020-02-01 with one availability domain and remains listed as an active public cloud region (me-jeddah-1). Region/city existence evidence, not a building-level record; no public MW.

name: center3 MENA Gateway 1 (MG1) Jeddah
notes: Submarine Networks describes MG1 as a Tier IV data center in Jeddah owned/operated by STC (center3) near JEDIX; DataCenterMap lists it. No public MW capacity.

name: Center3 Jeddah203
notes: Baxtel lists Center3 Jeddah203 as a carrier-neutral Tier III facility in Al-Idhaah near MG1 and JEDIX; center3 confirms a Jeddah footprint but publishes no site capacity.

name: Center3 MENA Gateway 2 (MG2) Jeddah
notes: OCOLO lists Center3 Jeddah MENA Gateway 2 with 9.60 MW power; center3 confirms Jeddah operations. Directory-level capacity, not operator-disclosed.

name: Mobily Jeddah data centers (Fayhaa and Obhur)
notes: Mobily official colocation page confirms Jeddah among its Saudi DC cities; DCD reports two operating Jeddah sites (Fayhaa, Obhur) among eight operating facilities. No MW disclosed.

name: Gulf Data Hub KAUST 1 (Thuwal, Jeddah Governorate)
developer: Gulf Data Hub / Data Hub Tech
notes: DCD: GDH broke ground Sept 2017 on a 27,600 sqm vendor-neutral DC at KAUST (Thuwal, within Jeddah Governorate), completed 2019, operated by Data Hub Tech with users incl. Aramco, Dow, SABIC. DataCenterMap lists 8 MW fully built-out.

name: Desert Dragon Jeddah data center (Phase 2, ICS Arabia)
developer: ICS Arabia / Lumaotong Group / China Mobile International
notes: ICS Arabia lists Jeddah phases targeted for late 2026/2027 within the 187 MW Desert Dragon program; DCD reported construction began Oct 2024; the Jeddah phase is ~50 MW. Program-level capacity split across sites.

name: Equinix Jeddah data center (100 MW pledge)
notes: Equinix pledged USD 1bn/100 MW Saudi data center investment (LEAP 2025) per trade coverage; BNC project database tracks an Equinix 100 MW Jeddah project. No official Equinix Saudi facility page yet, so grade C and status planned until official/permits appear.

name: Jeddah Data Center (JDC) - CST registered provider facility
notes: CST registered Data Center Services Providers list (decision 502/1445 regime) includes a Jeddah Data Center (JDC) with 'Limited' classification; registry confirms legal service status in Jiddah. Capacity not published by CST.

name: MODON data centre project - Jeddah Oasis (64 MW planned)
developer: MODON tenant (operator per MEED not confirmed)
notes: MEED reports MODON signed USD 1.7bn data centre projects (announced at LEAP) including a planned cloud-based data centre at Jeddah Oasis with ~64 MW capacity; operator attribution not fully visible in snippet - needs confirmation.

name: Center3 Shariya Makkah / NEIDC Makkah34
